title: Each batch merge mails every live session to refresh
why:
Owner 09:57 CST Nov 13 (via the retrospective): "we need to have some sort of auto update upon merge or something ... to ensure checkouts / sessions stay current". Start and owner prompts are the only refresh points today. Coordinator 00:57 CST Nov 15 (consultant 00:58): two lanes, both doing, started 00:56 CST, rebasing the open drafts. Lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy session_013NEJKzpBdiBYXja9cj5CoP carries #3020 (step field pr; REST 00:5x: open draft, head bc0b812ec521, mergeable_state dirty). Lane fast-forward-clean-start session_013NEJL1gBhLAKfnu1hoQKiy carries #3141 (open draft, head 07d1af67675f, dirty, review round 1 FAIL, fixes and round 2 pending per its PR body); the step has one lane and one pr field, so the second is held here. Both ids checked with get_session at 00:5x CST. The earlier lane session_013NEJL1XsPHDPWTxgsd5oS5 is replaced. 01:45 CST Nov 15: lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy (#3020) pushed head 9f8d1ead after the conflicted merge of main; its first fix check on 4c40d80e FAILED (caseK14 red, fixed in 9f8d1ead), the second on 9f8d1ead PASSED and is the only one posted (review record comment 6891202935). GitHub 01:44 CST: open draft, head 9f8d1eadc103, mergeable state unstable, base db3134aba78d (main moved since). Main's pr-review-record line 131 gives a fix after a FAIL fix verifier the fresh full review; no ruling covers a PASS after an earlier unposted FAIL. The lane recommends its posted PASS stands; the coordinator (01:43 CST) recommends one fresh full review at the live head, the route given to PRs 3465 and 3472. Owner item 866 (pick-3020-unposted-fail-fix) posted; b starred as the coordinator's recommendation; nothing parked on it.

02:34 CST Nov 15: the coordinator relayed "#3141 done" (runner 10's read). GitHub 02:34 CST: #3141 is an open draft, head e9484864e5ec, not merged (see step fast-forward-clean-start). So the #3141 part of this step has not landed; #3020 is also still open. Step stays doing.

02:38 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 02:40 CST, relayed): '#3141 done' meant runner 10's `merge --reviewed` row reads "done: round 1 FAIL, fix check passed" at head e9484864e5ec: that is review state, not a merge. PR #3141 is an open draft (triage REST 02:34 CST: head e9484864e5ec, not merged), with no replacing PR. This step stays doing.

02:49 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; triage read no code): lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy ran the fresh full review on #3020 (Sonnet, PASS at head 7f71cf292b17, no safety hole, so option b of owner item 866 was carried out). GitHub 02:49 CST: #3020 open draft, head 7f71cf292b17, mergeable clean, base ef36c765df2d, 13 files, 27 commits. Coordinator pick (undoable, not the owner's): the lane counts that full review as the tool's fix check (as #2870 did), then hands in. That reading of pr-review-record line 131 is unruled; item 866 stays open and carries a dated line saying so. Three low issues from the review: two are filed as the debt step install-record-after-warning (a failed settings merge or pointer write still writes the install record; a failed run's earlier record keeps the hook silent), one as a note there (install.sh:678-679 comment wrong for a failed first install).

03:20 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 03:12 CST, relayed; triage REST 03:15 CST): lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy handed in PR #3487, which replaces #3020 (#3020 closed unmerged 02:53 CST). #3487: open draft, head b6b1d652ac26, mergeable clean, base ef36c765df2d, 13 files, same tree as #3020's head 7f71cf292b17; the review is re-recorded on #3487 (record 6892087480, lane lint 6892161869 PASS, both relayed, not read by triage); relayed to runner 10. The three low notes from the review (install.sh:1104/1107/814 exit 0 and write the record; 678-679 wrong comment; 1258 earlier record hides a half-landed copy) are already filed in step install-record-after-warning. Owner items 870 (one ls-remote per cloud prompt; coordinator and lane recommend a) and 871 (debt reinstall-no-backoff: keep or back off; no recommendation) posted; the PR is not held on either. Item 866 (unposted FAIL fix check on #3020) is likely moot: #3020 is closed and the lane ran the fresh full review; it stays open until the owner or consultant says otherwise. 03:24 CST Nov 15 (coordinator's pick, not the owner's; undoable): #3487 head e4516d12bf62 is a merge of main atop plain commits, made before the fix-check record, so the merge tool refused the record. Pick (a): one plain non-merge commit fixing a nit of its fix check (the 'Filed 03:14 CST' time), then a fresh fix check, record and lint. Basis: ruling own-draft-rebase-lanes. Triage read (GitHub, 03:24 CST): PR open draft, head e4516d12bf62, 32 commits; docs/decisions/stale-install-cost.md at that head says 'Open: is one git ls-remote of origin per cloud prompt acceptable? Not ruled', so it does not answer item 870 for the owner. The lane said the coordinator ordered the cost into the decision; the coordinator finds no such order, so that claim is unsupported.
note: Group "sessions stay current": grants-read-from-main (done, #2978), fast-forward-clean-start (#3141), cloud-hooks-stale-copy (#3020), roadmap-ref-fresh-before-verdict, and this step. Shape (retrospective proposal; triage pick, undo: drop this step): at each batch merge, the merge sends one mail to every live session: "main moved to <sha>; refresh". Each session reruns the install refresh and fast-forwards a clean checkout (c36 shape). The same mail carries the role-text notice from step role-text-follows-ruling: one mail per merge. Rulings between merges arrive through roadmap-ref-fresh-before-verdict. Done when: a test merge mails two live sessions and both report the new sha. Coordinator 11:49 CST Nov 13: doing, express (owner 11:47 CST: "more mechanical than just each compaction"). Lane session_013NEJL1XsPHDPWTxgsd5oS5. Group sessions-stay-current with #3020, #3141 and compact-refreshes-hooks. Two lanes since 00:56 CST Nov 15; #3487 replaces #3020 (03:20 CST Nov 15): see why.
